distinct-staged-plan.why: Six clearly distinct stages: offline eval, shadow, dogfood, canary, staged GA tier 1, staged GA tier 2 — each with its own audience, duration, and purpose.

entry-gates-per-stage.why: Each stage has an explicit 'Entry gate' and 'Promote if…' column in the overview table, referencing concrete metrics measured in the prior stage.

kill-switch-with-fallback.why: Single feature flag kill switch with <2min activation time, and explicitly states fallback is the pre-existing 'no answer yet' experience with no broken UI or error messages.

precommitted-rollback-triggers.why: Numeric thresholds pre-committed for both automatic kill (e.g., >0.2% harm rate in 1-hour window, >$200 daily cost) and human-reviewed kill (e.g., flagged rate >5%, human reply drop >10%).

shadow-mode.why: Stage 1 is explicitly a shadow stage: 100% of live questions, output hidden, measuring real-world latency/cost/quality with no user risk.

multi-dimensional-gates.why: Gates and monitoring explicitly cover quality (helpfulness, accuracy, flag rate), cost (per answer, daily ceiling), and latency (p95, time to post) across all stages.

drift-monitoring.why: Steady-state section includes daily, weekly, and monthly eval cadences, a specific drift protocol triggered by 7-day declining helpfulness trend, and monthly full offline eval re-runs.
